title: Business Office Standard — Charges Booked at Move-In Under the Independent Living Residency Agreement
content:
On the move-in date under an Independent Living Residency Agreement, fees begin to accrue.

## Standard

**First month.** The first month is billed from the move-in date through the last day of that calendar month as a prorated move-in base fee charge, plus a prorated second person fee when the occupancy is double.

**Community fee.** The community fee is charged once per occupant position: the first-resident community fee of the apartment type at move-in, and the second-occupant community fee of the apartment type when a second occupant moves in with the resident or is added later.

**Entrance Fee Agreement holders.** The community fee is waived in full for a resident who holds an Entrance Fee Agreement for the apartment, and in that case no community fee entry is written.

**Trial or respite conversions.** A resident converting from a Larkspur trial or respite stay is charged the community fee and receives the respite conversion credit instead.

**Reservation deposit.** The whole reservation deposit held is applied at move-in as a deposit application credit referencing the deposit receipt.

**Status condition.** A community fee may be charged only while the residency is in active or notice given status.

## Decision table for the community fee

| Situation at move-in or when a second occupant is added | Community fee entry |
|---|---|
| First resident moves in; no Entrance Fee Agreement for the apartment | First-resident community fee of the apartment type |
| Second occupant moves in with the resident or is added later; no Entrance Fee Agreement for the apartment | Second-occupant community fee of the apartment type |
| Resident holds an Entrance Fee Agreement for the apartment | Waived in full; no community fee entry is written |
| Resident converting from a Larkspur trial or respite stay | Community fee charged; the respite conversion credit is received instead |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A resident holding a reservation deposit of 1,500.00 moves in on the 20th of a month: the first month is billed from the 20th through the last day of that month as a prorated move-in base fee charge, and the whole 1,500.00 is applied as a deposit application credit referencing the deposit receipt.
